title: phase 3: rate limit, duplicate-command guard and audit log (auth mode)
test_cmd: uv run pytest tests/api/test_guard.py tests/api/test_api_auth.py tests/api/test_api_phase0.py -q
criteria:
Guard middleware for the multiplayer (auth) mode. EDITING RULE: main.py has proofread Thai: make ONE small Edit (add the middleware inside create_app). All logic goes in the NEW file realm/api/guard.py. Everything below applies ONLY when settings.auth_required is True (read `from realm.settings import settings` at request time); with auth_required False the middleware must pass every request through untouched (existing tests keep passing).
== realm/api/guard.py ==
`class RateLimiter`: sliding window counter. `__init__(self, clock=time.monotonic)`; `allow(self, key: str, limit: int, window_s: float) -> bool` keeps a deque of timestamps per key, drops those older than window_s, returns False (and does NOT record) when the deque already holds `limit` entries, else records and returns True. `class DuplicateGuard`: `__init__(self, window_s: float = 1.0, clock=time.monotonic)`; `is_duplicate(self, fingerprint: str) -> bool` returns True when the same fingerprint was recorded less than window_s ago (and does not refresh the timestamp), else records it and returns False; old fingerprints are purged on each call so memory stays bounded.
`class GuardMiddleware(BaseHTTPMiddleware)` (starlette.middleware.base): only for methods POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE and paths starting with '/api/'. actor key = 'c:' + first 16 hex chars of sha256(session cookie value) when the cookie 'rov_session' is present, else 'ip:' + request.client.host (or 'ip:unknown'). Paths starting with '/api/auth/' ALWAYS use the ip key (brute-force protection). (1) rate limit: module-level `limiter = RateLimiter()`; if not limiter.allow(key, settings.rate_limit_per_10s, 10.0) -> return JSONResponse(status_code=429, content={'error': {'code': 'RATE_LIMITED', 'message': 'ส่งคำสั่งถี่เกินไป'}}). (2) duplicate guard (skip for /api/auth/ paths): module-level `duplicates = DuplicateGuard()`; fingerprint = sha256 of f'{key}|{method}|{path}|' + request body bytes (await request.body(); make sure the downstream route still receives the body — verify with a test that a POST with a JSON body still works through the middleware); duplicate -> 429 with message 'คำสั่งซ้ำ' and code 'RATE_LIMITED'. (3) audit: after the response is produced, call the module-level function `record_audit(token: str | None, method: str, path: str, status: int) -> None` through starlette.concurrency.run_in_threadpool; it opens `session_scope()` (realm.db.session), resolves the account via accounts.account_for_token(s, token, now) when a token exists (now = datetime.now(UTC)), the account's player in the newest world via accounts.player_for_account, and inserts AuditLog(account_id, player_id, method, path, status, created_at=now). Wrap the call in try/except Exception and ignore errors (audit must never break a request). Also audit the 429 responses of rate limiting and duplicates (status 429).
Tests tests/api/test_guard.py: unit tests for RateLimiter (allows `limit` then refuses, window expiry with a fake clock, separate keys) and DuplicateGuard (second identical within window refused, allowed after window, different fingerprint allowed, purge keeps dict small). Middleware tests with TestClient(create_app(serve_static=False)) and monkeypatch: settings.auth_required True, `guard.record_audit` replaced by a recorder function appending its args to a list (so no real DB is touched), `guard.limiter` replaced by RateLimiter() fresh per test, `guard.duplicates` fresh, and settings.rate_limit_per_10s set small (e.g. 3): POST /api/auth/login with a wrong password 3 times -> 401 each, the 4th -> 429 with error.code RATE_LIMITED; GET requests are never limited (call a GET 10 times with limit 3 -> never 429) and never audited; two identical POST /api/alliance/messages-style requests are not suitable (they need DB), so test duplicates on POST /api/auth/login? No: auth paths skip the duplicate guard — instead test the duplicate path by mounting a tiny extra route on the app inside the test: app = create_app(serve_static=False); @app.post('/api/_echo') async def echo(request: Request): return {'n': len(await request.body())}; then identical POST bodies within 1 s -> second is 429, a different body is 200, and the route sees the full body (n equals the byte length); the audit recorder receives (token_or_None, method, path, status) tuples for POSTs including the 429s; with settings.auth_required False nothing is limited, nothing audited (post the same request 10 times with limit 3 -> never 429, recorder list empty).
notes:
- Thai strings: use ONLY 'ส่งคำสั่งถี่เกินไป' and 'คำสั่งซ้ำ' (copy letter by letter). Do not retype any other Thai.
- Tests must not touch the real database (monkeypatch record_audit). Never commit; never call datetime.now() in services; run only the test_cmd files.
- Add the middleware in create_app with app.add_middleware(GuardMiddleware); the import goes with the other realm.api imports in main.py.
